The '''Catastrophic Mess''' was the nickname given by members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, to the combined kitchen and dining space at the [[Wraith Headquarters (Kuratooine)|Wraith base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]].<ref name="MK" />
